name: Virtua - Virtual Reality Experience
summary: Virtua is an immersive VR software developed exclusively for internal medical training at BD (Becton Dickinson). This cutting-edge platform allows medical professionals to engage in realistic virtual scenarios, practicing device usage and placement techniques in a safe and controlled environment. With Virtua, BD aims to enhance the skills and confidence of its personnel, ensuring they stay updated with the latest advancements in medical technology.
